paragraphs: Manchester Metropolitan University (Manchester Met / MMU) is a public university in central Manchester, England. With over 38,000 students, MMU is one of the largest UK universities and is best known for design (Manchester School of Art, founded 1838), sport science (Manchester Met Sport), business (AACSB-accredited), and creative industries.

International students enter via Manchester Met International College — Navitas's pathway college on the MMU All Saints campus. International Foundation Year and Pre-Master programs lead into an MMU Bachelor's or Master's degree.
paragraphsRu: Manchester Metropolitan University (Manchester Met / MMU) — государственный университет в центре Манчестера. Более 38 000 студентов — один из крупнейших UK university. Известен дизайном (Manchester School of Art, основан в 1838), sport science (Manchester Met Sport), бизнесом (AACSB-аккредитация) и creative industries.

Международные студенты заходят через Manchester Met International College — pathway-колледж Navitas на MMU All Saints Campus. International Foundation Year и Pre-Master программы ведут в бакалавриат / магистратуру MMU.
